speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease (COPD), likely a mix of emphysema and chronic bronchitis.

Given your significant smoking history, construction exposure, and X-ray findings of hyperinflation, the clinical picture strongly points to COPD. The lack of wheezing does not rule this out, as many emphysema patients have "silent" lungs due to destroyed airway walls. I recommend a Pulmonary Function Test (Spirometry) to confirm the degree of airflow obstruction and guide your treatment plan.
